notes: v3.9.8 = Conversion + credibility + engagement sprint (Wave 27). TBR viewers can now reach out to founders directly via a soft slide-in lead modal — founders get instant Telegram + email + inbox notifications. Cohort Compare no longer uses hardcoded medians — it fetches per-sector medians computed nightly from the anonymised BlockID cohort. And /workspace/notifications is now a proper inbox aggregating every event across a founder's reports (views, Q&A, leads, shares, analysis-done). Three additive migrations. Crontab entry for nightly refresh needs a manual add — seeded defaults serve until then.
